newsitem.title: USA: Nine feared dead in Texas plant explosion.
newsitem.headline: Nine feared dead in Texas plant explosion.

text.p: As many as nine people were killed and several others were missing after a massive explosion rocked an airplane parts plant on Monday, officials said.
The cause of the explosion was not known, but damage was said to be extensive in one portion of the plant, owned by the Wyman Gordon Forging Inc.
A spokeswoman for the Cy-Fair Volunteer Fire Department told Reuters that rescue teams at the scene "said there were nine dead and they were looking for six more people" in the rubble of the plant.
Local media reports said the death toll was anywhere from five to seven people. Company officials were not immediately available for comment or confirmation of the death toll.
Two other workers at the plant were injured and taken to a local hospital, where officials said they were in stable condition.

News reports said the force of the explosion threw workers as high as three stories into the air, although that could not be confirmed. They said some of the victims had to be pried from the wreckage.
